book.name: JUAN
book.title: SAN JUAN Maach peerdʉ aaujem Jesucristo igwia jöoi Juanau phã pʉatarr

content: Jesuu ich khapeen bʉ̈ ʉtarr

Ya phiesta Pascua anʉm burrju khãai ãbpai waaur sĩejim. Maagwai Jesuu khaphʉ sĩejim, ya ichdëu mʉg durr werpʉawi deeu ich Aai dʉ̈i ãba sĩeimaju ed pabaadëm. Thum mʉg jẽb gaai maar ich dënkha durrarr khʉʉnan bʉ̈ʉrjã chig aba jãsehne aajeejim. Maagjerr aawai ya ãbmiecha amau i thõoju ed paawaijã agtha ichdëu maar khõsi sim khaphʉ apijim.

Amau i magju ed maar i dʉ̈i thum ãba thach khö naajim, ya kheeuraa pamamua. Maagwain Judas Iscarioteen ya meperau pör meu thʉnaajim, Jesús oomapha aajem khʉʉnag i pʉr deeg. Chi Judas woun ãb Simón anʉm iewaa ajim.
Jesuu khaphʉ sĩejim, ich Ayau ichigta nem thum jaaunaa ʉ̈gtharmua ich pʉ̈itarr aawai deeu i aar maju.
Mag khaphʉ sĩerr aawai thach khö oo sĩewi, phiidʉbaadëwi, ich khajũa ʉ̈rʉm ẽernaa, jũrr toayaauta ãi jʉ̈ sĩsijim.
Magnaa thëp pör pömaam ee dö choonaa maar bʉ̈ ʉbaadëjim. Mag ʉnaa ichdëupai deeu mag toayaau wajapha jʉser jʉʉupʉ̈imajim.
Mag ʉkhapʉ̈pʉ̈igmamua ya Simón Pedro dën ʉag abaawai chi Simón Pedroou irig magjim: —Señor, ¿puata mʉ bʉ̈ ʉagá? ajim.
Magbaawai Jesuu irig, —Mua ĩs pãar dʉ̈i mʉg chirʉm pua pöd khaugba khabahab; pari ökharta pua khap abajup ajim, jãgwiata mua mʉg pãar bʉ̈ ʉ chirajĩ.

Magbaawai chará warag Pedroou irig, —Señor, pʉʉta mʉ khãai ʉ̈rpai sĩewai pʉrʉg chan mua mʉch bʉ̈ ʉpibamgui ajim. Magbaawai jũrr Jesuu chi Simón Pedroog, —Pua mʉrʉg pʉch bʉ̈ ʉpimapha chirʉm khai, magan ya tag pʉ mʉ dʉ̈i nʉrraju khaba simgui ajim irig.
Magbaawaita Simón Pedroou irig, —Señor, mag khai magan oob mʉ bʉ̈ appai ʉm. Mʉ bʉ̈jã ʉnaa, mʉ juajã ʉnaa mʉ pörpa sũurbapʉ̈i ajim.

Pari magbaawai Jesuu irig, —Ar ya wajapha domerwia nʉm khʉʉn tag domerju igba naabahab, ãba bʉ̈ appai ʉju aai nʉmgui ajim. Pãar thum khabahab mamʉ ya pãar wajapha domer nʉmjö thãar wajapha naabahab; ãba ãbpaita pãar ee domerbamjö thãar wajap khaba simgui ajim.
Irua mag maar ee ãb thãar wajap khaba sim a sĩerran, maach eem ãbmua imeraa wir aig ich pʉr deeju khaphʉ sĩerr aawaita mag sĩejim.
Mag Jesuu maar bʉ̈ ʉkhapʉ̈iwia, ũwaai ich khajũa jũapʉ̈inaa deeu mes gaai jupchëjim. Mag jupchëwia marag, —Ĩsin chadau mua pãrag jaaukhimgui ajim, khantheeta mua pãar dʉ̈i mʉg chirajĩ.
Chadcha pãrau mʉrʉg Maestro anaa Señor aajem; pãrau mag nʉm aig agchata iekha nʉmgui ajim.
Mag mʉ pãar Maestro anaa pãar Pörkha chirʉmuata pãar bʉ̈ mʉg ʉbarpí, pãraujã agjö jũrr chikham chogkha nʉmjö agdaujö dich khapeen bʉ̈ ʉju aai naabahab ajim.
Mʉg pãar bʉ̈ ʉbarmua mua pãrag ejemplota dee chirʉmgui ajim, pãragjã mʉch dënjö amkhĩir.

Pãadë khĩirjubat. Sĩi chikham chogkha nʉm khʉʉn chan amach pörnaan khãai ʉ̈rpai khaba, ni sĩi piyonnaankha nʉm khʉʉnjã amach patronnaan khãai ʉ̈rpai khaba aajemgui ajim. Ich agjöta naabahab ajim maachjã. Mʉ pãar Pörkha chirʉmuata pãach dʉ̈i jãgbarm oowia oob pãachta pãach khapeen khãaijã ʉ̈rpai nʉm a khĩirjuwia, “Maar chan chikham chogkhaju khaba nʉm” a khĩirjumiet ajim.
Pãrau ya mʉ iek ũrbarm; pãrauta mua nem jaautarr khĩirjunaa chadcha mʉ ipierraa mʉch dënjö nem wau wënʉrrʉmʉn, pãar onee wënʉrrajugui ajim.

’Mag pãar onee wënʉrraju a chirʉm chan, pãar thumaam khʉʉn igwiata mag jaauba chirʉmgui ajim, ãb pãar eem cha mʉchdëu jaau chirʉmjö onee khabaju aawai. Mua khaphʉ chirʉmgui ajim, chadcha mʉchdëucha jʉr autarr khʉʉn thãar. Pari ichiita Ẽwandam iek phã sim gaai “Mʉ dʉ̈i ãbam mes gaai thach khoojerraupaita ãsie mʉ khaibag wauju” a phã simjö, chadcha ich ag ee öbërmkhĩirta mua jãjã jʉr aujimgui ajim.
Ya mua ag nawe pãrag jaau chirʉmgui ajim, maagwai ya eeupemjö magbaadeewaijã pãrag mʉʉta chadcha ich Ẽwandamaucha jʉr auwia pʉ̈itarrau a khap amkhĩir.

Ãbmua mag wir aig mʉ khaibag waujup mamʉ, ichiita pãran mua pʉ̈i chirʉmgui ajim. Magua khaphʉ abat: Mua mʉch iek jaaumkhĩir pʉ̈i chirʉmta õraujã ʉ̈u pãar iek ũrm khõsi ũrnaa ʉ̈kha nʉmʉn magan mʉchdëucha jaaubarmta ʉ̈khabarmjö abarmgui ajim. Mag mʉ iek ũrm khõsi ũr nʉm khʉʉnaun magan ĩchab ich mʉ pʉ̈itarr iekchata ũr nʉmgui ajim ich Jesuu marag.
Jesuu jaauwai Judaauta i pʉr deeju ajim
Marag mag iekhawia warag ichta gaai machaaga aadëmua, —Chadcha mʉ cha iekha chirʉm iekhau pãar eem khʉʉnau ãbmua wir aig imeraa sĩi chikhamnag mʉ pʉr deejugui ajim.
Pari irua warre chi thʉ̈rcha jaauba arr aawai marau khaugba, sĩi jũrr chikham khĩirta agdaujö eerpag eerpag naajim.
Maagwai mʉ i bigaau i dʉ̈i ãba thach khö oo chirajim, mʉʉta ʉ̈rcha ichdëu jãsene aajerr aawai.
Mag mʉchta i bigaau chirarr aawai Simón Pedroou mʉrʉg juaupai jaaujim, khai igwiata mag sĩ a khap jëeumkhĩir.
Magbaawai mua chi Jesús simʉgaacha ĩiudʉnaa irig, —Señor, mag pua jaau sim, ¿khai igwiata mag sĩwi? a chirajim.
Magbaawai ich Jesuu mʉrʉg, —Oobá, pʉrʉg oomkhĩir mua pan omnaa agʉgcha deekhimgui ajim. Magnaa chadcha pan khõreunaa, omnaa, Judaagta deejim, woun ãb Simón Iscariote anʉm ag iewaag.
Mag Jesuu ichig pan omnaa ʉabaawai atham bʉ̈rre mepeer mag chi Judas pör ee dubtarrta warag ʉ̈rpabaadëjim. Magbaawai Jesuu irig, —Pʉchdëu wauju khĩirju simjö jöpai waubá ajim.
Pari mʉ khapeen dʉ̈i ãba thach khö narr khʉʉnau pöd khaugbajierram, jãgwiata irig mag sĩejim khai.

Ich chi Judaauta maar thumaam khʉʉn phatkhon dijã wai nʉrraajerr aawai maraun sĩita irig phiesta ee nem igjuuta për awaan mamkhĩir jaau simpii naajim; wa magbam khai, aphʉʉm khʉʉndamag khãijã ag eem deepi jaau sim khãijã anaajim.
Mag ichig pan ʉabapäaiwai, auwia, khöpʉ̈iwia, warre öbërbaadëjim maar aigmua. Maagwai ya edaar ajim.
Jesuu iek iiur jaautarr
Mag ya Judas öbërbaadeewai Jesuu magjim marag: —Ĩsta ya chadcha mʉch chi Emkhooi Iewaa jua theeg chirʉm thumaam khʉʉnau oogpam. Maagwai jũrr mʉ gaaimua Ẽwandamau ich jua theegjã oopiegpamgui ajim.
Mʉch chi Emkhooi Iewaau Ẽwandam jua theeg mʉg oopi chirʉmjö, ich Ẽwandamaujã ĩchab nau jöpcha mʉ jua theeg oopijugui ajim.

Mag iekhamamua ich thõoju igwia, ’Chaaina, mʉʉn sĩi khũchpaita pãar dʉ̈i chirajugui ajim. Mʉ petaawai parii pãrau mʉ jʉrju. Pari na mʉchdëu judionaan chi thierrnaan dakhĩir iekha chirarrjö, mʉʉgwaiwe chan pãar mʉ chiraimam aar pöd barju khaba naawai
pãrag iek iiurta jaau pʉakhim. Ma, mʉgaugui ajim: Jũrr agdaujö chikham kha khõsi abat. Mua jãg pãach khõsi wai chitʉmjö, pãraujã agjöta pãach khapeen kha khõsi abat.
Magta pãrau chadcha agdaujö chikham kha khõsi amʉn, thumaam khʉʉnau khaphʉ ajugui ajim, chadcha pãar mʉ khapeenkha nʉm.
Jesuu jaauwai Pedroou bʉ̈ʉrjã i khaugbam aju jaautarr
Mag i iekha öpinaa Simón Pedroou irig, —Señor, ¿pʉ jamag mamta mag sĩ? ajim. Magbaawai ich Jesuu irig, —Ĩswe chan pöd pʉ mʉ dʉ̈i mabam; pari ökharta ich agjö pʉ mʉ ẽudee majugui ajim Pedroog.
Magbaawai deeu ich Pedrooupai irig, —Señor, pari ¿khan jãgwi ĩswe mʉ pʉ dʉ̈i pöd maju khaba chirʉ́? ajim. Pʉ gaaimuan thõju akhiinjã mʉʉn thõju chirʉmgui ajim.

Magbaawai Jesuu irig, —¿Chadcha mʉ gaaimua pua ʉdʉraa pʉch thõopiju chirʉ́wi? ajim. Mʉ cha iekha chirʉm iekhau nau õrau pʉchig jëeuwai ãthãrr bĩeju nawe biek thãrjup pua amag bʉ̈ʉrjã mʉ khaugba chitʉm ajugui ajim.
